items.item: health.enroll’s words after brief 12’s scope resolution

health.enroll.entry: PapersWorkspace.tsx:561 (Enroll). Until 2026-10-13 this said :216, and until 2026-10-17 :548
health.enroll.reads: mayEnroll, programFor; HUSKY D’s work rules from 2027 (monthEngagement, health.ts:439-458: a month at the School, $580 of income of any kind with wages posted the record doesn’t hold, 65 or over or under 19, SNAP under its work rules, a stay in hospital asked for); the marketplace’s 60 days from the loss (marketplaceOpen, health.ts:699-719: Yale Health’s end at its hour, or a lapse reaching back from when it was made, lapseKnown, health.ts:727-734), from 2026-10-16: until then the month’s look’s hour was kept as the loss for Yale Health’s too, so a student withdrawn on 15 February 2027, uncovered from 17 March, was sold a plan until 31 May, not 16 May. Until 2026-10-17 monthEngagement read 80 hours’ work first, a branch brief 12 had cut (docs/verification/resolution-2026-10-17/health-criteria.md)
health.enroll.tests: Playable journeys, by path (docs/verification/resolution-2026-10-17/health-result.json, playableJourneys): the student, tests/evidence-g03-life.test.ts ‘at school, refused through the command in Yale Health’s words, and Papers offers no Enroll’, tests/scope-cover.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: at the School all of January 2027 and withdrawn on 1 February…’ and ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: on a personal leave from 20 January 2027, she enrolls in HUSKY D on Papers on 21 January, from 1 January…’; eligibility, tests/need-paths.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: an Inherited family’s savings at Capital One earn $6,436.10…’, tests/remaining-health-eligibility.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: an Inherited citizen withdrawn, her savings at $365,000…’, ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a student born in 1960, 66…’, ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: withdrawn, she applies for SNAP on Papers on 20 November 2026…’; enrollment, tests/evidence-g03-life.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: withdrawn, Enroll pressed puts them in HUSKY D from 1 November…’, tests/evidence3-lifepapers.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: the Inherited student’s marketplace, Enrolled from 1 November on Papers…’, tests/remaining-health-eligibility.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: withdrawn, with no work and under $580 of income in December 2026…’; renewal, tests/need-paths.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: on HUSKY D from 1 October 2026 on September’s $900.00…’, ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: the Comfortable family’s student, enrolled in HUSKY D on 1 October 2026…’, tests/remaining-health-eligibility.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: with no work and under $580 of income in April to September 2027…’; hardship, tests/remaining-09-hardship.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a stay in hospital in September 2027…’, tests/remaining-health-eligibility.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a stay in hospital in December 2026…’. Internal safeguards, apart: tests/defects-g8-4.test.ts ‘…since then the hours aren’t read: 80 hours paid $400 in June bring a notice of noncompliance…’, tests/remaining-health-billing.test.ts ‘FIXTURE: 80 hours’ work in November 2026 (posted by hand)…’, and the GUARD tests the result lists. Until 2026-10-17 this cited the work arm’s FIXTURE as its evidence for HUSKY D kept through work
health.enroll.issue: Fixed 2026-10-10: an enrollment waiting for its month is refused ‘You’re enrolled from …’ (mayEnroll), through the command across a reload in tests/evidence-g03-life.test.ts. 2026-10-17 (brief 12, section 3, a scope resolution): the work arm, unreachable in play since the owner’s scope reset of 2026-10-09 and deciding no outcome where reached, was found to serve no necessary purpose (no save holds 80 paid hours under $580: docs/verification/resolution-2026-10-17/health-criteria.md) and cut, alone (15a24e9d); the notices, Papers, the guide and the tutorial name the routes a player has, a month at the School, $580 of income or an exception, and none names hours of work (ab990173, 1d25b4ec); a renewal kept by a month at the School is played (c8c0b39f). Until then the row stayed partial on the work arm, as brief 11’s second reader decided
